(CCM: 0% of reviewed studies)
column3:

across Transformer (DGA), Generator (vibration/thermal),

column1:
Combined fault classification AND continuous RUL prognostics
in the same pipeline (treated as separate problems in 100% of studies)
column3:
AssetHealthPredictor exposes .classify() and .forecast()
from the same feature schema. RF and LSTM outputs are
complementary in one operator brief — never merged or conflated

column1:
Cross-unit generalisation testing for protection relays
(only 1 of 18 Fernandes corpus papers tested on unseen hardware)
column3:
Explicit ablation: train RELAY-0097 (100k ops), test on
RELAY-0139 (99k ops). Raw features: F1 = 0.725 →
per-unit z-score features: F1 = 0.943

column1:
Standards-traceable operator advisory (no paper in either
review corpus links model output to a verified maintenance clause)
column3:
Deterministic RAG (no LLM): exact-tag lookup → paraphrased
clauses from IEGC, CBIP Pub. 295/296, CEA 2010,
IS 12075:2008, IS 10118 (Pt IV), CG AL-Series O&M manual.
Every sentence has source_doc + source_section

column1:
Physics/DT validation of proposed corrective actions
(non-mutating evaluation loop: not implemented in any reviewed study)
column3:
copy.deepcopy(Nlive) for every candidate action. Real
Newton-Raphson AC power flow on the copy. Only the
winning action is written to the live grid state.
Bisection recovery: 65.5 MW shed → GRI 49.0 → 61.0

column1:
IoT / IIoT interface for live telemetry-fed classification
(only 2 of 96 CCM cells covered; AIoT: 0%)
column3:
DigitalTwinClient polls live simulated telemetry over HTTP
from the pandapower IEEE twin (FastAPI + WebSocket).
Not a real substation IoT deployment — simulator acting as
IIoT proxy, validated against real training-data baselines

column1:
Real-field operational validation — 80.6% of transformer PdM
papers use only benchmark/retrospective data (Aeggegn et al.)
column3:
Three real-data sources used: relay endurance (199k real
switching operations, 2 physical units), steam-alternator
plant log (real hourly telemetry, no synthetic augmentation).
IEEE twin operates as a validated physics proxy, not a
real substation — deployment gap explicitly documented

column1:
Ground-truth RUL target (most prognostic papers use derived
Health Indices, not observed failure countdowns)
column3:
Relay endurance: RUL = (total_ops − 1 − op_index) —
genuine countdown from a real run-to-failure endurance test.
Transformer / Generator / CB: derived HI / severity index
used instead (dataset limitation documented, not hidden).
Per-asset target rationale published in paper Section 3.8

column1:
Class imbalance handling in DGA-based transformer classifiers
(majority normal class inflates accuracy, masks rare fault recall)
column3:
class_weight='balanced' in RF (wᵢ = n / (C·nᵢ) per class).
T1 class: only 6 samples — still classified at F1 > 0 with
balancing. Macro F1 (not accuracy) is the headline metric
throughout. No SMOTE or GAN used (data distribution preserved)
